# E0208: name defined twice

A name is defined once in its scope, and Stilt has no overloading. Give the second definition a name of its own.

- Rule: [`declarations.unique-names`](../../reference/10-declarations.md#declarations.unique-names)
- Reported at: the later of the two names. For a `use` declaration, the declaration, and for a test, its `test` keyword.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0208:3
fn total(prices: List<i64>) -> i64 { prices.fold(0, |sum, p| sum + p) }

fn total(prices: List<f64>) -> f64 { prices.fold(0.0, |sum, p| sum + p) }
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn total(prices: List<i64>) -> i64 { prices.fold(0, |sum, p| sum + p) }

fn total_f64(prices: List<f64>) -> f64 { prices.fold(0.0, |sum, p| sum + p) }
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0208_name_defined_twice.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0208_name_defined_twice.lt):

```text
── NAME DEFINED TWICE ───────────────── E0208_name_defined_twice.lt:3:4  [E0208]

`total` is already defined in this module:

  3 │ fn total(prices: List<f64>) -> f64 { prices.fold(0.0, |sum, p| sum + p) }
    │    ^^^^^

A name is defined once in its scope, and Stilt has no overloading. Give the
second definition a name of its own.
```
